Position: Assistant Professor - Computer Science and Engineering
Institution: Example Institute of Technology (synthetic test posting)

Eligibility
Ph.D. in Computer Science and Engineering or related discipline is essential.
First class Master's degree (M.E./M.Tech) in CSE.
Candidates must have qualified UGC-NET / SET / SLET or hold a Ph.D. as per UGC Regulations 2018.
Minimum 2 years of teaching or research experience.
Publications in Scopus indexed journals are required.

Desirable
Experience with Machine Learning, Deep Learning and Python is preferred.
Knowledge of Cloud Computing and Data Structures is desirable.

Responsibilities
Teach undergraduate and postgraduate courses in Data Structures, Machine Learning and Algorithms.
Guide student projects and research scholars.
Publish research in reputed journals and apply for funded research projects.
Contribute to curriculum development and NBA accreditation activities.
